fixed.notes: No candidate may raise risk percent, leverage, grid exposure, or force broker minimum volume.

families.name: Pattern Selection - Cypher restriction probe
families.hypothesis: If Cypher weakness is structural, removing it should raise PF floor across clean Development windows without causing unacceptable frequency collapse.

families.name: Winner Capture - partial TP simplification
families.hypothesis: If winner truncation is material, disabling non-grid partial TP should improve average winner and realized RR while preserving DD.

families.name: Tail / Stop Geometry - modest ATR contraction
families.hypothesis: A modest stop-geometry contraction may reduce loser expansion without risk amplification.

families.name: Regime / HTF Alignment - strict H1/H4
families.hypothesis: If counter-trend/regime mismatch causes negative expectancy, strict directional alignment should raise PF floor even at lower frequency.

combination_family_E.rule: May combine only factors that independently improve Development PF floor and preserve DD <=10%; do not predefine an interaction candidate.

v29_4_allowed_only_if: clean Development evidence shows repeated performance failure not expressible by existing parameters
required rule is cross-window rather than tailored to known losses
